text:
incident-bot: Pager P1 — high GPU queue growth in europe-north1. Autoscaler attempting scale-up but GCP returns quota/limit errors. Impact: several hosted inference routes degrading. Paging oncall.

alexa: on it. seeing spike in pending queue: +2.3k requests in last 5m. tail latency up ~8x. throwing 429s to a subset of customers.

julian: any error codes? gcloud output?

alexa: logs show quotaExceeded / resourceQuotaExceeded from GCP when creating GPUs. snippet:
```json
{"error": {"code": 403, "message": "Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for region europe-north1.", "status": "PERMISSION_DENIED"}}
```

mira: confirm this is not our IAM denial — looks like regional GPU quota cap. GCP console shows current limit = 24 GPUs, requested burst >24.

lia: which pools are impacted? is this dedicated or hosted?

alexa: hosted & some dedicated lanes hitting the same region because scheduler routed warm pools there. impacted model-heavy routes: /v1/generate-large, chat-xl.

ops-bot: Auto-routing policy triggered fallback to nearest region (europe-west4) for non-low-latency customers. Applied policy: failover=noisy. See rollout id `reroute-2026-03-15-01`.

julian: can we temporarily move low-priority traffic to smaller quantized variants? e.g., model-x-8q -> model-x-4q.

alexa: yes, starting a soft downgrade via config flip on 3 routes. will monitor error surface.

mira: also start a manual scale in eu-west4 and ap-northeast1 to absorb traffic. provisioning there has spare quotas.

lia: are we blocking customer requests (429) or queueing them? need exact customer impact.

cs-rep: just got a ping — some SMB customers see generation errors, a couple of enterprise customers reported increased latency but no data loss. raising proactive comms.

alexa: current mitigation plan summary:
- Apply model downgrade for low-priority routes (inflight)
- Reroute new requests by policy to eu-west4
- Spin up reserved instances in eu-west4 and ap-northeast1
- Engage GCP quota support for emergency bump
- If needed, enable preemptible-backed pools as last resort

mira: who's owning customer comms? cs-rep please coordinate with affected account teams.

cs-rep: on it. drafting an interim note: "We're experiencing regional GPU capacity constraints. We're routing traffic and running mitigations; some requests may return transient errors. We'll update within 30m." will attach list of affected org ids in a follow-up.

julian: quick checks:
`kubectl get pods -n inference | grep europe-north1` -> shows pending create due to quota error.
`gcloud compute regions describe europe-north1 --project=redwood-inference` -> shows GPU quota usage.

alexa: trying a controlled retry/backoff for queued requests to avoid thundering herd. lowering default concurrency for impacted routes to 8.

ops-bot: note: autoscaler attempted 6 scale actions in last 4m; all aborted with 403 from provider.

mira: tentative timeline: 10m to finish downgrade rollout; 20-30m for cross-region capacity to come online; quota increase depends on GCP support (unknown). If quota bump denied, we'll keep rerouting and maintain degraded capacity.

lia: any short-term hack to reduce GPU pressure? e.g., reduce max decoding steps, lower batch sizes?

alexa: reducing max tokens from 1024 -> 512 for heavy endpoints, and forcing batching knob to prefer larger batches (reduce p99 CPU) — pushes throughput efficiency up ~20%.

julian: create runbook entry and attach logs for postmortem. we may want to tune warm pool placement to avoid single-region concentration.

alexa: handing off to mira for next steps/monitoring. mira, you're oncall for the next 45m. @mira take over.

mira: ack — I've taken the lead. continuing mitigation and tracking customer impact. will update every 15m or on significant change.

(15m later)

mira: update: downgrade rollout complete for low-priority routes. Reroute policy effective; eu-west4 absorbing ~65% of traffic. eu-west4 reserved instances are provisioning now (expected ready ~18m). queue length in europe-north1 down 78%.

cs-rep: sent interim notice to 12 affected customers. one enterprise asked for ETA; provided 30-60m window.

ops-bot: GCP support responded: auto quota review started; tentative uplift possible in 2-6 hours, but not guaranteed.

julian: for post-incident: we should add a safeguard to avoid warmpool concentration: scheduler should prefer >2 regions when scaling warm pools.

mira: agreed. I will open a follow-up ticket: "regional-warmpool-dispersal" and assign to eng-infra.

alexa: logs and key metrics pushed to incident folder: `s3://redwood-incidents/7532109876/metrics/`.

mira: closing loop for now — severity downgraded to P2 since customer impact reduced and routing mitigations in place. leaving thread open until eu-west4 capacity stable.

cs-rep: will keep customer comms cadence. thanks team.

incident-bot: Incident note appended to ticket #INC-2026-1191. Handoff complete.

mira: final note before locking: please include cost impact estimate for cross-region spill in the follow-up. lia, julian, alexa, assign owners.

lia: will take cost estimate.

julian: will draft infra followups: warmpool dispersal + autoscaler guardrails.

alexa: will write runbook for quick model downgrade toggles.

mira: thanks. locking thread but will reopen if GCP replies with quota bump or if errors resurface. :white_check_mark:
